ORDERS.TITLE: Orders

NOT_CONNECTED.AGENT: No Shopify store is connected. An administrator can connect one.
NOT_CONNECTED.ADMIN: Connect your Shopify store to see and manage orders here.
NOT_CONNECTED.NO_ENCRYPTION: Encryption must be configured on this installation before a store can be connected.

BROKEN.TEXT: The store connection needs attention: Shopify no longer accepts it.
BROKEN.AGENT_HINT: Ask an administrator to reconnect the store.

ORDERS.UNAVAILABLE: Shopify did not answer. Orders cannot be shown right now.

REFUSED.TEXT: Shopify refuses the connected app the store's orders and customers.
REFUSED.ADMIN_HINT: In the Dev Dashboard open the app's Distribution and choose custom distribution, then check again.
REFUSED.AGENT_HINT: Ask an administrator to look at the store connection.

LIMITED.TEXT: This store does not share customers' personal data with the connected app, so orders are found by order number only.
LIMITED.WHY: Names, emails and addresses are unavailable and the address cannot be changed here. Shopify gives them to an app created in the Dev Dashboard with custom distribution.

ORDERS.NO_IDENTIFIER: This contact has no email or phone number. Find an order by its number.
ORDERS.NONE: No customer of the store matches this contact. Find an order by its number.
ORDERS.STALE_CHOICE: The customer chosen earlier no longer exists in the store.
ORDERS.AMBIGUOUS: More than one customer matches this contact. Choose the right one.
ORDERS.KEEP_CUSTOMER: Keep this customer for the contact
ORDERS.NO_ORDERS: This customer has no orders in the last 60 days.

MANAGE.REMOVE_CONFIRM: Remove the store connection? The credentials are deleted; earlier notes and action records stay.

ORDER.ADDRESS_HIDDEN: Unavailable: the store does not share it.
ORDER.CUSTOMER_HIDDEN: Customer unavailable: the store does not share it.
ORDER.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Outcome unknown. Check the order in Shopify.
ORDER.MARK: This conversation is about this order
ORDER.MARKED: This conversation is about this order

WHY_NOT.unknown_order: The store no longer has this order.

EDITED.INVOICE_SENT: The store emailed the customer an invoice for the balance.
EDITED.INVOICE_REFUSED: The store did not send the invoice: {message}
EDITED.INVOICE_UNKNOWN: The store did not confirm the invoice: check the order in Shopify before sending it again.

MARKS.READ_FAILED: The current note could not be read from Shopify. Try again.
MARKS.UNKNOWN: Shopify did not confirm the change. Check it in Shopify before trying again.
MARKS.LACKS: Tags and the note cannot be changed here: the connected app lacks {scopes}.

WHY_NOT.customer_data_hidden: Unavailable: the store does not share its customers with the connected app.
WHY_NOT.unknown_order: The store no longer has this order.
WHY_NOT.unknown_customer: The store no longer has this customer.
WHY_NOT.store_unreachable: Shopify did not answer. Nothing was changed.

DIALOG.FAILED_PLAIN: The action could not be performed.
DIALOG.UNKNOWN: The store did not confirm. The outcome is unknown: check the order in Shopify before trying again.
DIALOG.RUNNING: Shopify is still working on it. The order shows as cancelling until it is done.
DIALOG.NOT_ALLOWED: An administrator has not allowed you to act on orders.

CANCEL.RESTOCK: Put the items back in stock

CONNECT.TITLE: Connect Shopify

KIND.client_credentials: App from the Dev Dashboard (client ID and secret)
KIND.legacy_token: Older custom app (Admin API access token)

CONNECT.SCOPES_WRITE: write_orders: cancel, refund, address, order tags and note. write_customers: customer tags and note. write_draft_orders and read_products: replacement orders. read_locations and read_merchant_managed_fulfillment_orders: putting refunded items back in stock.

DIALOG.SENT_AS_IS: What was sent can no longer be changed here: confirming again asks how that request ended.

ORDER_ROLES.TITLE: Who can act on orders
ORDER_ROLES.INTRO: Administrators can always cancel, refund, change addresses and send replacements. Agents can only after you switch it on for them.
ORDER_ROLES.FAILED: The list could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

RULE_PRESETS.TITLE: Ready-made automation rules
RULE_PRESETS.INTRO: Rules that use what your store knows about the customer. Switching one on creates an ordinary rule in the automation list, where you can change it like any other. Switching it off deactivates that rule and keeps your changes.
RULE_PRESETS.FAILED: The rules could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
RULE_PRESETS.NOT_CONNECTED: No store is connected to this account yet. The rules can be switched on, but they act only once a Shopify store is connected.
RULE_PRESETS.RULE: In the automation list it is the rule “{name}”.
RULE_PRESETS.SWITCH_FAILED: The rule could not be switched. Try again.
RULE_PRESETS.MARKER_NOTE: A rule belongs to its switch by the last line of its description. If you remove that line, the switch shows as off and switching it on creates a new rule.

DISCOUNTS.TITLE: Discount codes
DISCOUNTS.INTRO: The discounts agents may give from a conversation. An agent picks one and changes nothing. A code keeps its conditions when its preset changes later.
DISCOUNTS.FAILED: The page could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
DISCOUNTS.NO_PRESETS: No presets yet. Agents cannot give discount codes until you add one.
DISCOUNTS.REMOVE_CONFIRM: Remove this preset? Codes already given stay valid.
DISCOUNTS.WHO_INTRO: Separate from who may act on orders. Administrators always may.

value.less_than_or_equal_to: A percentage can be at most 100.

expires_in_days.not_a_number: Enter a number of days, or leave it empty for never.
expires_in_days.greater_than: At least 1 day, or leave it empty for never.

base.failed: The preset could not be saved. Try again.

SLA.TITLE: SLA policies
SLA.INTRO: How fast conversations must get a first reply from a person and be resolved. A new conversation gets the first policy in this list that covers its inbox; the targets it gets do not change when the policy is edited later.
SLA.FAILED: The policies could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
SLA.EMPTY: No policies yet: conversations have no SLA timers.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.TARGET_HINT: Leave one of the two empty if you need only the other.
FORM.BUSINESS_HOURS: Count business hours only (as set in each inbox's settings)

ERRORS.TARGET_NEEDED: A target is needed: set a first response, a resolution or both.
ERRORS.TARGET_POSITIVE: A target must be more than zero.
ERRORS.TARGET_TOO_LONG: A target can be at most 365 days.
ERRORS.INBOXES_NEEDED: Choose at least one inbox, or let the policy cover all inboxes.
ERRORS.NOT_SAVED: The policy could not be saved. Try again.

LIST.DELETE_ASK: Delete this policy? Timers it started on open conversations stop.

NEW_ORDER.TITLE: New order for {name}

NEW_ORDER.PREFILLING: Loading the items of the order…
NEW_ORDER.SKIPPED: Not available for sale, not added: {items}.
NEW_ORDER.NO_LINES: No items yet. Search the catalogue above.
NEW_ORDER.STALE: The order changed. Calculate the total again.
NEW_ORDER.DELIVERY_EMAIL: The store emails its invoice to {email}
NEW_ORDER.DELIVERY_EMAIL_HINT: The email is the store's own invoice template, as set in Shopify.
NEW_ORDER.DELIVERY_REPLY: Put the link into the reply

AWAITING.TITLE: Awaiting payment
AWAITING.UNCONFIRMED: The store did not confirm a new order yet. It shows here once Shopify has it.

inclamo_refund_full.LABEL: Refund the order in full
inclamo_refund_full.DESCRIPTION: Refunds everything still refundable on the order tied to the conversation. The items are not put back in stock. Shopify notifies the customer.
inclamo_refund_full.EFFECT: Refunds {amount}, everything still refundable. The items stay out of stock. Shopify notifies the customer.

inclamo_refund_shipping.LABEL: Refund the shipping cost
inclamo_refund_shipping.DESCRIPTION: Refunds only the shipping cost of the order tied to the conversation; the items are not refunded. Shopify notifies the customer.
inclamo_refund_shipping.EFFECT: Refunds the shipping cost, {amount}. The items are not refunded. Shopify notifies the customer.

inclamo_cancel_order.LABEL: Cancel the order
inclamo_cancel_order.DESCRIPTION: Cancels the order tied to the conversation at the customer's request, refunds it in full and puts the items back in stock. Shopify notifies the customer. Cannot be undone.
inclamo_cancel_order.EFFECT: Cancels the order and refunds {amount}. The items go back in stock. Shopify notifies the customer. This cannot be undone.
inclamo_cancel_order.EFFECT_UNPAID: Cancels the order. Nothing was paid, so nothing is refunded. The items go back in stock. Shopify notifies the customer. This cannot be undone.
inclamo_cancel_order.EFFECT_REFUNDED_BEFORE: Cancels the order. Everything paid was refunded before, so nothing more is refunded. The items go back in stock. Shopify notifies the customer. This cannot be undone.
inclamo_cancel_order.EFFECT_AMOUNT_UNKNOWN: Cancels the order and refunds whatever is left to refund; how much could not be checked just now. The items go back in stock. Shopify notifies the customer. This cannot be undone.

inclamo_replacement.LABEL: Send a free replacement
inclamo_replacement.DESCRIPTION: Creates a new order in Shopify with the same items of the order tied to the conversation, to the same address, at no charge to the customer.
inclamo_replacement.EFFECT: Creates a new order with the same {units} items to the same address, at no charge. Stock is taken.

CONFIRM.TITLE: Run the macro "{name}"?
CONFIRM.LOADING: Asking Shopify what this macro will do…
CONFIRM.FAILED: What this macro would do to the order could not be checked. Try again in a moment.
CONFIRM.NO_ORDER: No order is tied to this conversation, so its order steps have nothing to act on. Tie the order in the Orders section first.
CONFIRM.WILL_STOP: Will not be done: {reason} The macro stops at this step and the steps after it do not run.
CONFIRM.AFTER_STOP: Will not run: the macro stops at an earlier step.
CONFIRM.CHECKED_AGAIN: Everything is checked again with Shopify when the macro runs. The result is written as a private note.
CONFIRM.CHANGED: This macro was changed while you looked at it. Close this and run it again to see what it does now.
CONFIRM.NOT_RECORDED: Your confirmation did not reach the server, so the macro did not run. Try again in a moment.
CONFIRM.NOT_OPENED: The confirmation of this macro could not be opened, so it did not run. Try again in a moment.
